--- Page 5 --- WILLIAMHAGAR AGANCHEIG Ia ming 11 chimonggimin kan'dikgipa goiporangko iga chonchongipa bi'sarangna miksonge chapa ka'ataha.
Tarang toe skiani gnanggipa aro bisarangko gisik μngatbegnigipa golporang ong'a.
Golpo mingantina anga tingsa ba minggni noksarangkoba on'aha.
Anga bebe ia golporangko bi'sarang aro dal.dalgiparangba inikgen.
On'gimin noksarang golponi katta aro obostarangna raa ongjanaba gnang aro seani rokom-bewalrangba praigipa sakantini namnikani gita ongjanaba gnang.
.nggijarangko  namdapate, chu'onggijarango  on'dape esokode aro iani bidingo saoba angna maiba ku'patianiko I'genchimode, sonako, muktako gita anga uarangko mchatnikbegenchim.
Ia kitapko poraiachi dal.drobaenggipa skie ra'eng- Achik bi'sarang mingsasiksik maiba dakchakaniko namgnikode man'chongmotgen ine anga ka'donga.
MITELBEA SToWMan J.

SUKROBAL SAL Kamrup districtnt salgipengo badiaba burung-bolgrimni jatchio chongipa gitim damsa dongachim.
Song jelja, nokking bang'ja, abrirangni gisepo chongipa a'kaweosa biapna krakra gtim gimiko nok l6 mangmangsan dongaia.
Gitimni salaram saliram aro salgroo nina nitoriri bo'rot-bo'tot ongipa a'brirang guare gita dultoka aro salgipengchipako cholguga gita chibima dilsani rikamona king- king a'kawe dakjoljolangachim.
Ia a sal gnanggipa a'kaweo mi- misirangko ge e-game cha'ana agreba chibimani rikamranga ma'manti me'su-sam jakrangni baganrangkoba dakna man'achim.
Indaken ia biapo manderang nengraen kusi ong'e janggi tangna cholko man'a- chim.
Ua gitimo buchuma saksa dongachim.
Gitimni a'palo chibi.
gimikgimik dongachim Indaken bi'sarag ua buchumako gisepo uamangni gitimo nikoba uamangni gitimonin ong'a ine uijachim Da'alo Good Friday ong'a.
Bi'sarang skul chuti man'toka.
Ia salo bi'sarang pilakan rona, kal'na, ring'na chio jroe rona aro eko ska ukon dakna jakgitel ong'tokachim.
Good Fridayni pringnt gilja mutchoto bi'sarang buchumani a'dapona dakanggipa rama gitan saksa sakgipinna katta agangrikjoljole re'baengachim.
Bu- chumuni jamdapona sokon uamang ua nokchiko nie adita cha- dengtokaha.
Ua nokko galchipgimin nok gita nikachim.
" Angade ia blapkode namnikjasai,' saksa aganaha.
" Angaba namnikjasai," sakgipin aganpaaha.
" Angade ia nokkode skalni nok gitasan nikaiade." "Oe.
Skalrangde pangnan songni chel'ao chibimarangni rikam rangosa nok rike dongrongana.
Aro mandsba ong'chong, matchuba ong'chong, saksan-mangsan roamgipakode chike cha aiana." Indaken bi'sarang an'tangtangni gisepo betbete saksa sak.
gipinni agana kattarangna aditan kena naptokaha.
Buchumaba --- Page 10 --- bi'sarangni jik jakata'niknirigent iwg Katbsafir.
Bi'farang kenbeaha aro katna am'engachim, indiba buchuma uamangni kenako nike an'tangong rerhachina jakjipataha.
Kenbeoba bi'sarang buchumani sepangona re'batokaha.
Buchuma uamangna maiba namgijuko dakgen ine uanang kensoengachim, maina giseposan ua gitimona re'barongaiani gimin mikmaltokjachin.
A'bachengo bi'sarang ua buchumako namgijagipa ine chan- chiachim, indiba dikdiksani ja'manon uni ka'sae daka aro agana- nirangko nike uamang ua buchumako namgipa aro ka saninggipa ine uina man'aha.
Uamang da'o buchumana kenchajaha, batesa uko namnikbatrorona a'bacheugaha aro bon kamao uamang uko namnikbeaha.
Buchumaba bi'sarangna ka'saaha aro it neng'takani salo uni gital dambe ripengrangko seng gnang watatpilna sikpiljaha.
Indiba mai cholchi bi'sarangko ua ru'utbatkale an'tangni jamdapo rikkina man'gen ?
Mai cholchi ua bi'sarangko an tangn!
nannika gita jamdapo an tang baksa tlongalnu man gen?

Maibachi uamangko kusi ong'atna man jaode aro namnamgipa, su'ugipa, gistk nangat- begnigi'na aro skidapanian gapgipa golporangk , agane uamanglli gisikrangko salna aro ka'tongrangko muni nangatna mun'jaode ku'sikarichide uamangko an'tangni nangvika gita an'tung baksa!
jamdapo dongatna man'jawa ine ua nikaha.
"Na'simang tom'tome asongiokode aro angna nachil song- buchuma aganakas "Ka'sapae ambi, chingna golpo aganbo.
Chinga tomn'tome aro gisiko nange knatimtokgen,' chrochro bi'sarang agantokcha' "Indakode anga na'simangna ENA aro MENA minggipa abisani golpoko cgangen."
